candidates.name: Yeouido Hangang Park
candidates.description: Yeouido Hangang Park is a popular public park situated in Yeouido, the center of the financial district. Its proximity to Yeouinaru Station makes it highly accessible and is always bustling with activity. In the spring, the park is renowned for its cherry blossoms. In the autumn, it hosts the Seoul International Fireworks Festival, drawing numerous tourists with various performances and events. The park features a range of sports facilities, including gateball courts, inline skating rinks, soccer fields, and grassy areas. Bicycles are available for rent. An outdoor swimming pool is open during the summer, offering a refreshing escape from the heat. Additionally, the nearby Bamseom and Yeouido Saetgang Ecological Park are well-preserved natural areas that provide opportunities for ecological learning and various programs.

candidates.name: Changsin-Sungin Quarry Observatory
candidates.description: The quarry observatory is built atop the summit of Changsin-dong quarry, providing a panoramic view of the city and natural landscapes at a glance. During the Japanese colonial period, a quarry was located in Naksan, Changsin-dong, to supply stone for the exterior of large buildings such as the Government-General of Korea, the old Seoul Station, and the Bank of Korea. After the Korean War, the quarry's use was discontinued, but the quarry observatory was located where immigrants and refugees settled to form a village. From the quarry observatory, with nothing obstructing the view, you can enjoy the skyline of Seoul at a glance. The second floor houses a coffee shop (Café Nakta), and the third floor features an outdoor observation deck, allowing you to appreciate the scenery of Seoul's cityscape and nature from any vantage point. Especially renowned is the breathtaking view that unfolds alongside the sunset. Enjoy the best panoramic view, a reasonably priced cup of coffee, and homemade ggangjeong and Nakta rice cakes. Small music concerts featuring historical and cultural stories, exhibitions, and live guitar performances are held occasionally.

candidates.name: Hanyangdoseong (Seoul City Wall)
candidates.category: History > Historical Sites > Others Historical Sites
candidates.description: The Seoul City Wall was originally built in 1396, surrounding Seoul (then known as Hanyang) during the Joseon Dynasty (1392-1897). The wall stretches for 18.6km along the ranges of Bugaksan Mountain, Naksan Mountain, Namsan Mountain, and Inwangsan Mountain. The wall stands at average heights of 7 - 8 m high. Along the Seoul City Wall, there once stood eight gates that were originally built between 1396-1398, but only six remain standing. The North, South, East, and West gates of the wall are known as the “Four Great Gates” (Sukjeongmun, Heunginjimun, Sungnyemun, Dongeuimun), while the Northwest, Northeast, Southwest, and Southwest gates are known as the “Four Minor Gates” (Changuimun, Hyehwamun, Gwanghuimun, Soeuimun).

candidates.name: Tongui-dong Alley
candidates.description: This alley, located west of Gyeongbokgung Palace, preserves historical value as a site related to Gyeomjae Jeong Seon and Chusa Kim Jeong-hui, where logistics movement and human exchange for Gyeongbokgung Palace were once active. During the Joseon Dynasty, great artists like Gyeomjae Jeong Seon and Chusa Kim Jeong-hui resided in Seochon. In modern times, notable artists, including painters Lee Jung-seop and Lee Sang-beom, and poets Yun Dong-ju and Yi Sang, were also residents. We hope you will enjoy exploring history and culture together in Tongui-dong Alley, where a cultural village has been established with various cultural and artistic spaces, such as the Boan Inn, where poets Yi Sang, Yun Dong-ju, and painter Lee Jung-seop once stayed.

candidates.name: Hongjecheon Stream
candidates.description: Hongjecheon Stream is the first tributary of the Hangang River. The stream runs 13.92km-long and flows through Jongno-gu, Seodaemun-gu and Mapo-gu. The stream was historically also referred to as Hongjewoncheon Stream due to its proximity to the Joseon-era Hongjewon rest area. Visiting Chinese envoys and officials would often stop by here to refresh. Today, Hongjecheon is famous for its waterfall and bicycle path.

candidates.description: Sewoon Cheonggye Shopping Mall, built as a residential and commercial building in the 1960s, appeared as "Geumga Plaza" in the drama Vincenzo and has become a hot place to visit ever since. This shopping mall is considered to be the first electronics shopping center in Korea. Its name "Sewoon" means "a place that collects the energy of the world." Nowadays, visitors can find the popular cafes of the Euljiro district here, such as Horangi Cafe. Additionally, from the rooftop of the Sewoon Cheonggye Shopping Mall, visitors can see the fantastic night views of Namsan Tower, Cheonggyecheon Stream, and the Jongno district. Visit Sewoon Cheonggye Shopping Mall and the popular cafes in the Euljiro district as you recall scenes from your favorite TV series.

candidates.name: 부루의뜨락
candidates.description: 부루의 뜨락은 1978년 개업하여 현재까지 운영되고 있는 음반가게입니다. 영화와 드라마에도 장소가 등장한 명동의 명소이자 중고음반점의 대명사로 알려져 있습니다. 1층은 케이팝 음반과 굿즈, 2층은 재즈와 팝송CD, 3~4층은 클래식 레코드 판을 판매하고 있습니다. 약 10만장 이상의 음반 중에서 클래식 LP가 특히 많습니다. 잘 찾아본다면 1980-90년대 미국 흑인 뮤지션들의 희귀한 음반도 찾아볼 수 있습니다. 1990년대 들어 대중들의 취미활동이 변화하면서 음반 구매율이 줄어들기 시작했고, 일본 LP애호가들이 음반을 높은 가격에 사가기 시작하면서 이 시기부터 주 소비층이 외국인으로 바뀌었습니다. 1990년 후반부터 국내 음반판매점은 한류 가수들의 앨범을 일본에서보다 저렴하게 구입할 수 있어 한국을 찾는 일본인들에게 필수 관광코스로 각광을 받아왔습니다. 당시 회현지하상가를 중심으로 명동 일대에는 11개 음반가게들이 있었고 그 중에서 ‘부루의 뜨락’은 터줏대감 역할을 하였습니다. 현재에는 K-POP이 세계적으로 알려지면서 동남아나 유럽에서 온 손님들이 음반을 찾는 경우도 있어 최대한 다양한 종류의 음반을 갖춰 놓게 되었습니다.

candidates.name: 대림중앙시장
candidates.description: 대림중앙시장은 영화 '범죄도시'의 배경으로 등장하면서 서울 속 차이나타운으로 많이 알려졌습니다. 영화에서는 사건사고가 많은 공간으로 묘사되었지만, 실제 분위기는 밝고 활기찹니다. 좌판에 펼쳐진 중국식 만두와 소시지, 연변 순대 등 중국 음식을 하나씩 맛보며 먹거리 탐방을 하는 것만으로도 짧은 여행을 하듯 즐길 수 있는 이색적인 시장입니다.
reviews: 서울 영등포에 위치한 대림중앙시장, 서울 속의 이국적인 모습입니다

이 전통 시장에 대해 많이 들어왔는데, 드디어 음력 설날 첫날에 방문했어요. 한국의 대부분 상점들이 연휴라 문을 닫았을 거라고 생각했는데, 생각보다 사람들이 많아서 놀랐어요. 시장을 돌아다니면서 마치 중국에 온 것 같은 기분이 들었어요. 중국 제품을 파는 가게들이 많았고, 두리안을 비롯한 다양한 아시아 식료품들도 팔고 있었거든요. 분위기도 활기차고 흥미로웠어요. 서울에 오시면 꼭 한번 방문해 보시길 추천해요. 정말 즐거운 시간이었어요.
안 좋네요, 왜냐하면 루작 칭구르를 파는 사람이 아무도 없거든요 🙂‍↔️…

서울 차이나타운은 꽤 흥미로운 곳입니다. 한국 화교의 영향이 뚜렷하게 느껴지는데, 반찬 가게도 많고, 양꼬치도 많고, 동북부 중국 음식도 맛볼 수 있습니다. 일본, 싱가포르, 미국 차이나타운과는 다른 독특한 인구 구성과 한국-중국 문화의 영향을 느낄 수 있습니다. 이곳에서 일하는 사람들 중에는 한국어를 아예 사용하지 않고 중국어로 말하는 사람들도 있습니다. 주로 쓰이는 언어는 중국어와 한국어이고, 영어로 소통하기는 어려울 것 같습니다. 정통 중국 양념과 반찬을 사기에 좋은 곳입니다. 채소와 해산물은 다른 곳에서 사는 게 좋을 것 같습니다.
중국 상인과 한국 상인의 외침이 뒤섞인 전통 시장은 구경하기에 꽤 즐거운 곳이다.

candidates.description: Cheongnyangni Traditional Market became the first market in Seoul in 1964 when so-called "bundlesang" gathered around Cheongnyangni Station, which became a key point for material distribution and passenger transportation due to the operation of the Gyeongchun Railway and the opening of the Jungang Line. If you want to come across old traditions and a variety of food, head to the Cheongnyangni traditional market.
